main_text.p: Antequam vocalium puncta à Maforethis inventa sunt, tres quiescentes ו א omnium vocalium vices supplebant, unde matres lectionis dicebantur: א indicabat Pathach & Camets. ו o & u; scil. cholem, camets chatuph, schurec, & kibbuts. erat pro e & i; scil. pro tfere, segol, & utroque chirec. Jod etiam chateph-segol vocalem breviffimam annotabat & aliquando fimplex fcheva.

Hinc fit, ut post inventa & superaddita vocalium puncta, relictis illis consonis quae vocalium erant indices confusa extiterit punctatio, tum in Targumim seu paraphrasibus Chaldaicis (quae confusio quum in Venetis, tum in Regiis Bibliis passim invenitur, & summo labore Buxtorfii in Bibliis Basilienf. sublata est) tum in variis scripturae locis, ut Pfalm. 77.10. ubi in [illegible, ~4 letters] Jod post Lamed, quod non pluralem numerum sed scheva denotabat, post additam vocalem relictu est; sic etiam Pfalm. 120. 5. [illegible, ~3 letters] pro [illegible, ~3 letters], ubi ו non Shurec sed Kibbuts sequente daghes secundum analogiam denotaret: vide Lud. de Dieu. Gram. l. 1. c. 7. Sixtinum Amam. & alios, praecipue librum eruditissimum Lud. Capelli ab Erpenio editum, Punctationis arcanum revelatum inscriptum, cujus lectio cordatos omnes (paucis quibusdam pervicacibus exceptis) in suam sententiam de punctorum & accentuum novitate adduxit; quae vero nuper edidit vir quidam doctus contra Capelli Arcanum, ita jejuna & frigida sunt, ut paucos (nisi fallor) sibi confentientes habeat.
Cholem cum supra ו notatur sic [illegible, ~1 letter], dicitur Vau

page.notes: Printed page number is "(9)" at the head, centred. No running head. Hebrew and Hebrew-pointed words are only partly legible at this scan resolution; they are marked illegible rather than guessed. The vav glyph "1" in "1 non Shurec" and "supra 1 notatur" is read as ו with [?] omitted because the form is clear. Signature "D 5" at the lower left is slightly blurred. Long s is rendered as plain s throughout. The catchword "Cholem" is printed at the right foot.
